text:
Put the exercises you want to progress early in the session.
Five easy minutes on the bike before lifting.

horizontal-leg-press.text: Face forward. Judge depth by count, not by watching the stack.

seated-cable-row.text: Bend your knees to fetch the handle, chest up. Don't fold forward to reach it.

seated-pec-deck-fly.text: Stay at 30 kg until the first set reaches 20.

seated-machine-chest-press.text: When all three sets reach 15, go to 60 kg.
